«Bloom Boutique - Bandra» is located in Mumbai. This boutique hotel is located in 3 km from the city center. You can take a walk and explore the neighbourhood area of the boutique hotel — Juhu Beach, Versova Beach and Powai Lake.

At the boutique hotel

Spend an evening in a nice atmosphere of the bar. You can stop by the restaurant. Have a cup of coffee in the cafe and, who knows, maybe it’s going to be the best one in the city. Want to be always on-line? Wi-Fi is available.

If you travel by car, you can park in a parking zone for free. If you travel by car, there’s a parking zone. The tour assistance desk of the boutique hotel will help you book an excursion. For the free movement around the city, the boutique hotel offers a transfer for you.

There are other services available for the guests of the boutique hotel. For example, a laundry, dry cleaning, ironing, press, car rental, a safe-deposit box and a concierge. The staff of the boutique hotel will be happy to talk to you in English and French.

Room amenities

In the room, there is a shower, a mini-bar and slippers. The room equipment depends on its category.

detail.address: Bulding No. 8, Saki Vihar Complex, Mumbai
detail.description:
Location

A great hotel to have a nice rest before long walks around the city. Hotel «Tuliip Residency» is located in Mumbai. This hotel is located in 7 km from the city center. You can take a walk and explore the neighbourhood area of the hotel — Powai Lake, Juhu Beach and Versova Beach.

At the hotel

It’s time to have a nice meal! Stop by the restaurant. Want to be always on-line? Wi-Fi is available. If you travel by car, you can park in a parking zone. For participants of business meetings, there is a business center.

The tour assistance desk of the hotel will help you book an excursion. The staff of the hotel will order a transfer for you. Accessibility: there is an elevator/lift. Additional services that the hotel offers to its guests: a laundry, dry cleaning, an ATM, ironing, press, car rental, a safe-deposit box and a concierge.

The staff of the hotel will be happy to talk to you in English.

Room amenities

Guests will find the following in the room: a shower and a TV. The room equipment depends on its category.
